name: pi-openrouter-top
description: Replaces pi's OpenRouter model list with a static top-50 snapshot (top-weekly ranks from https://openrouter.ai/models?order=top-weekly, pinned 2026-08-18). Provider override is fed from the static file openrouter-top50.json in this repo, so the ACB/pi picker shows exactly 50 curated-by-usage models instead of pi's ~300-model built-in snapshot. Static by design — no refresh machinery.
